title: Nexus WorkAuthoringApi
description: Handler-local wire DTOs for the Work authoring family (`works-api` destination): authoring pool entries/list, pool set-active/promote/archive, inspiration items/list/add/promote/archive and the chapter reconcile report. `creator_id` never crosses the wire: the surface is local-first and always the active creator (R-V141P1-11). Wire shapes mirror the retired daemon-local envelopes verbatim.

WorkPoolEntry.title: WorkPoolEntry
WorkPoolEntry.description: One authoring-pool entry as served on the wire (the stored `creator_id` is intentionally not serialized).

work_id.description: Work the entry points at; empty when the entry has no Work yet.

WorkPoolSetActiveRequest.title: WorkPoolSetActiveRequest
WorkPoolSetActiveRequest.description: Body for `POST /v1/daemon/works/pool` (set the pool-active Work). `action` is the legacy action word (`set`); `creator_id` is accepted for legacy parity but the stored Principal stays the only identity.

action.description: Legacy action word; values other than the stored `set` action are rejected by the core authority.

creator_id.description: Legacy optional caller echo; never authorizes — the native Principal is minted from the opened core.

WorkPoolPromoteRequest.title: WorkPoolPromoteRequest
WorkPoolPromoteRequest.description: Body for `POST /v1/daemon/works/pool/promote` (promote a queued Work into the pool and set it active).

set_default.description: Legacy redundant flag: promotion always sets the entry active.

WorkInspirationItem.title: WorkInspirationItem
WorkInspirationItem.description: One inspiration-pool item as served on the wire (the stored `creator_id` is intentionally not serialized).

rel_path.description: Workspace-relative file path of the inspiration note.

promoted_work_id.description: Work the item was promoted into, when promoted.

WorkInspirationAddRequest.title: WorkInspirationAddRequest
WorkInspirationAddRequest.description: Body for `POST /v1/daemon/works/pool/inspiration` (scaffold a new inspiration note).

WorkInspirationPromoteRequest.title: WorkInspirationPromoteRequest
WorkInspirationPromoteRequest.description: Body for `POST /v1/daemon/works/pool/inspiration/promote` (atomically create a Work from an inspiration item and mark it promoted).

idea.description: Optional `initial_idea` override for the created Work.

set_default.description: Set the new Work pool-active after creation.

WorkInspirationPromoteResponse.title: WorkInspirationPromoteResponse
WorkInspirationPromoteResponse.description: Response for the atomic inspiration promotion (legacy three-write transaction).

WorkReconcileReport.title: WorkReconcileReport
WorkReconcileReport.description: Chapter reconcile counters (DB-as-SSOT resync); identical for the dry-run preview and the committed run.
